company_name: 广东新宝电器股份有限公司
decision_frame: Assess the pre-cutoff durability of the consolidated small-appliance operating model, cash conversion and financing needs without using post-cutoff outcomes or market prices.
underwriting_route: Underwrite the established appliance export platform on reported normalized earnings, while treating working-capital and long-lived-asset commitments as cash and financing qualifiers.

situation_model.summary: The company is a large export-oriented small-appliance designer, manufacturer and seller with a broad product set and an integrated customer solution; growth remained positive through FY2017 but earnings and operating cash conversion became less consistent.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Scale and product innovation can support continued demand, but raw-material, currency and channel working-capital variability make margins and cash conversion uneven.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit pools favor suppliers that combine product design, certification, tooling and reliable mass production; excess input costs, foreign-exchange movements and inventory or receivable intensity can divert value from manufacturers.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The company derives the large majority of sales from small appliances and approximately 88% of FY2015 sales from overseas markets, exposing results to global demand, currency and customer concentration.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: Its one-stop market-strategy, design, tooling, testing and mass-production capability, broader product lines and automation investments provide an adaptation path, subject to evidence that returns exceed the associated capital and working-capital commitments.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Reported earnings are substantial and recurring in operation, but FY2017 margin pressure from raw-material prices and higher finance expense shows that normalized economics should be expressed as a range rather than a point estimate.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Permanent loss would most plausibly arise from a sustained loss of export demand or customer relationships, structurally weaker product economics, or capital and working-capital commitments that cannot be recovered; current evidence does not establish such a break.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a bounded primary earnings route for the established operating platform; keep cash-conversion and growth-capital questions explicit and conditional rather than converting incomplete evidence into a point value.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: International small-appliance brands and Chinese manufacturers offering comparable design-to-mass-production capability
reversal_observations: Two consecutive years of weakening operating cash flow relative to earnings together with rising receivable or inventory intensity.
Sustained raw-material or foreign-exchange pressure that lowers operating profitability despite product and automation initiatives.
Evidence that major customers or export channels are lost without replacement by new products or customers.

business_position: A scaled, export-led small-appliance platform with design, tooling, certification and manufacturing capabilities across kitchen, home-care, baby and personal-care categories; FY2015 overseas sales were 88.06% of revenue.
survival_case: The company remains solvent while its diversified product platform and customer programs generate operating cash; survival depends on managing receivables, inventories, supplier terms, currency exposure and ongoing asset spending through demand cycles.
adaptation_case: Broader product lines, innovative products and automation can defend the platform and improve productivity, but the return on growth capital and the durability of customer adoption remain conditional evidence questions.
normalization_case: Use FY2015-FY2017 recurring consolidated earnings as a bounded reference range, recognizing FY2017 raw-material and currency pressure and excluding non-recurring items from the normalized interpretation.
permanent_loss_map: Monitor export demand and customer retention, product-level margins after raw-material and currency changes, and whether working-capital plus asset commitments impair liquidity; absent a sustained break, treat loss paths as conditional rather than base.

value_route.route_reasoning: A primary route can be supported by the established operating earnings base. Growth-return and detailed owner-cash routes are not promoted because the source package does not provide a complete maintenance-versus-growth spending split or return-on-growth calculation.

strongest_rival: International small-appliance brands and Chinese manufacturers offering comparable design-to-mass-production capability
reversal_observations: Two consecutive years of weakening operating cash flow relative to earnings together with rising receivable or inventory intensity.
Sustained raw-material or foreign-exchange pressure that lowers operating profitability despite product and automation initiatives.
Evidence that major customers or export channels are lost without replacement by new products or customers.

component_treatments.reason: The consolidated appliance design, manufacturing and sales platform generated recurring revenue and positive reported earnings across FY2015-FY2017.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the base operating earnings case, with a range reflecting raw-material and currency variability.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote confidence if subsequent reports show stable product demand, margins and customer retention across the core platform.

component_treatments.reason: Receivables and inventories are material relative to the operating scale, while customer-level cash terms and cycle attribution are not fully disclosed in the package.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Owner cash and financing pressure depend on whether working-capital growth normalizes with sales or becomes structurally heavier.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote to base cash treatment when audited periods demonstrate stable or improving receivable and inventory days through a cycle.

component_treatments.reason: Long-lived-asset spending increased from FY2015 to FY2017 and included disclosed technology-upgrade projects, but maintenance versus growth allocation and returns are not separated.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: All-spending cash and financing pressure are real, while normal owner cash requires a conditional maintenance-capital range and a separate growth-return assessment.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote growth spending into a return-bearing route only after project-level completion, useful-life and incremental-return evidence is available.

component_treatments.reason: The company added or purchased subsidiaries across the three years, but the package does not isolate their contribution to consolidated earnings or cash generation.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Acquisition contribution is excluded from the base earnings bridge and retained only as a scenario and permanent-loss consideration.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote when segment or subsidiary disclosures establish recurring incremental earnings and cash returns after integration costs.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Stable demand, margin and customer-retention observations across a subsequent cycle.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Sustained loss of core customers or product economics that reduces recurring earnings capacity.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Audited cash-cycle data show working-capital intensity stabilizing or improving with growth.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Receivables or inventories continue to outgrow sales and require recurring external funding.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Project-level evidence links spending to incremental volume, margin and cash returns.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Asset programs consume cash without demonstrated utilization or incremental returns.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Subsidiary disclosures show recurring post-integration earnings and cash contribution.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Acquired or newly formed entities remain loss-making or consume cash without strategic contribution.

evidence_trace.scope: Business model, product categories and integrated design-to-production services
evidence_trace.used_for: Core operating platform and adaptation capability

evidence_trace.scope: FY2015 product and geographic revenue mix, including 88.06% overseas sales
Revenue, attributable profit, adjusted profit and operating cash flow

evidence_trace.locator: FY2015-FY2017 annual reports pp.87-96 and FY2015 pp.18-20
evidence_trace.scope: Long-lived-asset cash spending and disclosed technology-upgrade projects
Subsidiary additions, ownership change and FY2017 acquisition cash payment

evidence_trace.locator: FY2015-FY2017 annual reports p.8 and p.10
evidence_trace.scope: Non-recurring items and management explanations of raw-material and currency pressure

underwriting_thesis.central_path: A scaled export manufacturing platform can sustain a recurring earnings base if product breadth and integrated execution offset input-cost, currency and working-capital volatility.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use a bounded FY2015-FY2017 recurring earnings reference; treat FY2017 margin pressure as a range risk rather than a terminal break.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Operating cash is positive but owner cash remains conditional on maintenance-capital needs, total asset spending and working-capital intensity.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Keep permanent-loss paths conditional on sustained export/customer erosion, structurally impaired margins or unrecovered capital commitments.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is the established core earnings platform; growth-return and detailed cash routes remain excluded or conditional until missing evidence is disclosed.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: International small-appliance brands and Chinese manufacturers offering comparable design-to-mass-production capability
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Track export demand and customer retention, raw-material and currency effects on margins, receivable/inventory days, operating cash versus earnings, asset-spending returns and subsidiary contributions.

investment_treatment: Pre-outcome underwriting only: maintain a conditional core-platform thesis and require the stated reversal observations before changing the economic judgment.

basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated Guangdong Xinbao Electric Co., Ltd. reporting perimeter

rows.economic_reason: FY2015-FY2017 attributable and adjusted earnings establish a recurring operating base while FY2017 raw-material and currency pressure justify a range.

low.basis: Illustrative downside demand case anchored to the documented export concentration.

base.basis: Maintain the latest observed export scale as the base case.

high.basis: Illustrative upside scale case consistent with product breadth and integrated capabilities.

normal_earnings.basis: The package does not provide product-level margins or customer-specific volume elasticity.

delta.reason: Revenue mix and margin pass-through are not sufficiently disclosed to quantify earnings sensitivity.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not convert the scale cases into a numeric earnings adjustment; retain the bounded reference range.

owner_cash.basis: Working-capital and capital-spending responses to export volume are not separately disclosed.

delta.reason: Cash conversion elasticity cannot be isolated from receivables, inventories and asset spending in the supplied package.
delta.conservative_treatment: Keep owner-cash treatment conditional and avoid a point estimate.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Company operating platform and disclosed consolidated reporting; excludes unobserved customer-level elasticity and post-cutoff events.
